messages.content: You are evaluating a supplied plan in a tool-dependency cost graph. Use only the visible current type state, tool input/output types, and current tool costs. RETAIN means the provided suffix is still minimum execution-cost under the current tools (ties are RETAIN). SWITCH means a strictly cheaper type-feasible suffix exists. Do not consider LLM tokens, replanning latency or business validity. Compare EXACTLY the supplied incumbent suffix and one additional feasible goal-reaching candidate. The candidate is not labelled as optimal or better; it is the same path in both factual conditions. Use current tool values, choosing SWITCH only if the candidate is strictly preferable, otherwise RETAIN. Reply ONLY JSON with {"intervention":"RETAIN" or "SWITCH", "old_total":number, "candidate_total":number}.
